`mci_error_non_fatal_check` (`src/integration/asserts/caliptra_ss_top_sva.sv:230-234`) has only an `else $display("SVA ERROR: ...")` action. A failing assertion therefore prints a message and does nothing else, with no `$error` or `$fatal`.

I found nothing elsewhere in the repository that scans logs for "SVA ERROR" or otherwise turns the message into a test failure. I did not read the regression or pass/fail scripts in full, so that part rests on a repository-wide search rather than a complete read.

My first submit attempt used the wrong tool name and failed; the second attempt was accepted.
